symbolDescription:
The overridable interaction surface.

Each handler is `(ctx, next) => void`. Call `next()` (optionally with a partial
context override) to run the built-in behaviour; skip it to cancel.

optionDescriptions.onBeforeChange: Wraps every content change; skipping `next()` vetoes it.
optionDescriptions.onPaste: Wraps every paste, including the sanitization that follows it.
optionDescriptions.onDrop: Wraps every drop onto the content element.
optionDescriptions.onUploadStart: Wraps each upload before the file leaves the browser.
optionDescriptions.onUploadError: Wraps the reporting of a rejected or failed upload.
optionDescriptions.onKeyDown: Wraps every keydown, before the keymap acts on it.
optionDescriptions.onLinkClick: Wraps a click on a link inside the content.
optionDescriptions.onLinkOpen: Wraps following a link, which is where a confirmation belongs.
optionDescriptions.onToolbarCommand: Wraps every toolbar activation, which is where analytics belongs.
optionDescriptions.onBlur: Wraps focus leaving the editor (fixes R9).
optionDescriptions.onMaxLengthExceeded: Wraps what happens when input would pass `maxLength`.
optionDescriptions.onSanitizeViolation: Wraps the reporting of something the sanitizer refused.
optionDescriptions.onSourceViewToggle: Wraps opening and closing the HTML source view.
